note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. Only the supplied relationships are drawn: plain relations carry no arrowhead, sequence links are shown 'as configured', and no causal link is drawn unless the author supplies one. Blank rows on a sheet are supplied blank rows; nothing is inferred about them. Times are illustrative and imply no time limit. Editable brief fields: items, custodians, timestamps, records, elements, relationships, focusElement, relationLabels, traversalOrder.
